capabilities.userProblem: Analyze authorized user-provided videos without transmitting them to a server.
capabilities.implementation: Visible multi-file upload; approval before hashing; metadata preflight; adaptive samples with skipped and failed interval accounting.
capabilities.modelOrRule: browser decoder and deterministic sampling policy
capabilities.output: video metadata, coverage, sampled frames and decode failures
limitations: Browser codec support and memory limits vary by device.

capabilities.userProblem: Locate observable objects in sampled video frames.
capabilities.implementation: YOLOS-tiny browser adapter loaded at an immutable revision with WASM fallback.
limitations: No consented held-out surveillance benchmark; boxes do not establish identity.

capabilities.userProblem: Group detections into local tracks within one video.
capabilities.implementation: Two-stage high/low-confidence matching with source-scoped track identifiers.
capabilities.output: source-scoped local tracks and trajectory points
limitations: Not full ByteTrack parity; no Kalman filter, global assignment or cross-video identity.

capabilities.userProblem: Find evidence candidates using observable text or a local reference image.
capabilities.implementation: Privacy-aware parser, structured filters, optional pinned CLIP embeddings, relevance/recency ranking and near misses.
capabilities.input: observable-language query or reference image and indexed evidence
capabilities.output: ranked candidates, score explanation and near misses
capabilities.validationDataset: labelled repository fixture for workflow only
limitations: Threshold is unvalidated; similarity is not probability; fixture does not prove model quality.

capabilities.userProblem: Retain investigation state locally across page lifecycles with bounded retention.
capabilities.implementation: IndexedDB v2 evidence, video, track, search, association, action, incident and settings stores; startup purge and explicit reset.
limitations: Best-effort browser storage can be evicted; purge runs when the application opens; exports escape retention.

capabilities.userProblem: Review plausible cross-video continuations without claiming identity.
capabilities.implementation: Uncalibrated appearance/semantic/topology/time fusion with conflict evidence, open-set rejection and visible human confirmation or rejection.
capabilities.input: local tracks, embeddings, camera/time constraints and optional reviewer decision
capabilities.output: appearance-similar candidate, plausible association, human-confirmed association or inconclusive
limitations: Threshold is not calibrated and no output establishes identity.

capabilities.userProblem: Communicate an unsuccessful candidate search without asserting definite absence.
capabilities.implementation: Validated wording plus analyzed duration, skipped intervals, decode failures, limitations, threshold and near misses; inconclusive on inadequate coverage.
limitations: Cannot prove that a person or object was absent outside analyzed coverage.

capabilities.userProblem: Export reviewed evidence and its decision trace locally.
capabilities.implementation: Local JSON export with coverage, limitations, candidates, reviewer decisions, action trace and SHA-256 integrity field.
limitations: Not a trusted timestamp, signer, immutable log or legal chain of custody.

capabilities.userProblem: Prevent unsupported or false-positive observations from escalating into actions.
capabilities.implementation: Observe, validate, deterministic policy, optional judge, judge validation, proposal, approval, execution, outcome verification, retry/compensation and closure.
capabilities.modelOrRule: authoritative deterministic policy with optional non-authorizing judge
capabilities.input: observation, use-case evidence contract, action allowlist and approval
capabilities.output: closed, suppressed, pending approval, unavailable or compensated trace
capabilities.validationDataset: deterministic positive and negative control fixtures
limitations: No authenticated external service is configured on GitHub Pages.

capabilities.userProblem: Send or execute consequential actions through authenticated services.
capabilities.implementation: Controls remain disabled on GitHub Pages and require approval plus a configured authenticated service elsewhere.
capabilities.output: unavailable on the public static deployment
limitations: Email, tickets, dispatch, access control, emergency messaging and external evidence transmission are not available.

capabilities.userProblem: Exercise review controls reproducibly without claiming model accuracy.
capabilities.implementation: Visible repository fixture and false-positive scenario are explicitly labelled simulation.

capabilities.userProblem: Prevent demographic or biometric proxies from influencing operational outcomes.
capabilities.implementation: Age, perceived gender, body proportion and gait are rejected from normal query, rank, retention, association and action paths; facial recognition and watchlists are absent.
limitations: Research would require a separately governed lab and is not part of this build.
